{{Top}}
A '''thermal imaging scanner''' was a device which used heat signatures to determine how many people were in a room, and where. It had a pistol grip similar to a [[Loudhailer/Legends|loudhailer]]. One end of the device was a display, the other was a lens.

During their [[Raid on Jabi Town|raid]] on [[Jabi Town]], thermal imaging scanners were used in conjunction with [[Ben Skywalker]] and [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo's]] [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]].
